# Sophron

Sophron is a policy plane for autonomous agent payments over x402 on Hedera.
Agents can buy services; deterministic policy decides reject, pending approval, or auto-pay before signing.

Tagline: Self-control for autonomous payments.
Supporting: Agents can buy. They just can’t overspend.

## Human dashboard

- Cinematic product story at `/`
- Interactive control plane at `/dashboard`
- Control plane UI for policy, UTC-day spend, agent runs, and payment attempts
- Approve / deny for pending_approval attempts
- HashScan links for settled payments

## API (backend)

Base URL defaults to http://localhost:4021 (override with PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL).

- GET  /api/policy
- GET  /api/attempts
- GET  /api/attempts/:id
- POST /api/attempts/:id/approve
- POST /api/attempts/:id/deny
- POST /api/agent/run
- POST /api/demo/reset

## Demo services

- risk-report — low cost, auto-pay when allowlisted
- market-brief — higher cost, human approval
- unknown-provider — non-allowlisted merchant (reject)

## Principles

- LLM owns intent and service selection
- Application code owns policy, signing, and money movement
- Buyer private keys never enter the browser
